calibmsg: Tap when you hear the pulse.
chaplock: Get {n} stars in chapter {c} to unlock.
wonat: You had already won: the rest was a bonus.
winsub: ★★ secured · keep going if you like
pausewon: Victory secured: you can stop whenever you want.
how1b: Each tile falls toward the glowing line. Tap its column as it reaches the line, anywhere along its height.
how2b: A missed tile ends the run. When two tiles arrive together, use two fingers. On a long tile, keep your finger down until the end.
how3b: Chain hits without errors: the combo and the multiplier (up to ×4) climb. PERFECT is worth more than GREAT, which beats GOOD.
how4b: Last 1 min 30 and you have WON: at least 2 stars, guaranteed. The rest of the song is a bonus challenge: if you fail at 1:31, you still won!
how5b: During those 90 seconds, tiles fall faster and notes get denser. Crossing the golden marker means victory.
how6b: Win a song to earn at least 2 stars. 5 stars in a chapter open the next one. Losing before 1:30 earns nothing.
how7b: Play with sound on: tiles play sounds you pick in the shop (percussion, marimba, bells…), tuned to the song. If tiles feel off-beat, run the calibration. The phone back button pauses. Practice mode (×0.75) is made for learning.
norew: No reward: you must last {t} to win.
tierlock: Win all {m} songs of the current level to open {t} ({n}/{m}).
modinfo: Variants: Mirror flips the columns, Ghost hides tiles before the line, Turbo speeds up (+15% score). Each variant adds 25% coins.
audioerr: Audio unavailable for this song. Try again, or run "Check audio" in Settings.
how8b: Win every song of a level to open the next: same songs, but more tiles, faster, with long holds and chords. The numeric difficulty never drops from one level to the next.
how9b: Mirror, Ghost and Turbo change how you play the same song and earn more coins. Spend them on themes, effects, tile styles, trails, combos, sounds and titles.
